ValidationRule.description: Ensures that the value of the Document Model is correct based on the customer subscription model
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT($Setup.Setting__c.Bypass_Validation_Rules__c), OR( TEXT(Person__r.Subscription_Model__pc) = 'ila', TEXT(Person__r.Subscription_Model__pc) = 'alburaq' ), TEXT(Document_Model__c) != TEXT(Person__r.Subscription_Model__pc) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Invalid value of the Document Model on the Content record. Please contact your administrator.
